query: SELECT ar.cliente, so.estadoConfiguravel, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM accounts_receivable ar INNER JOIN sales_orders so ON ar.cliente = so.cliente WHERE ar.estado = 'EMITIDO' AND so.estadoConfiguravel IN ('BAMBU', 'MADEIRA', 'ROJÃO', 'SERRAGEM') GROUP BY ar.cliente, so.estadoConfiguravel ORDER BY ar.cliente, cnt DESC LIMIT 30
